method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (two gaps answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Superannuation (Unclaimed Money and Lost Members) Act 1999, Compilation No. 42, compilation date 28 September 2022, includes amendments up to Act No. 127, 2021 (register id C2022C00273), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00518.txt. No instrument is deposited: unclaimed money days and scheduled statement days are inputs; the interest the regulations work out is not computed. sumlma-regulations.l4 (from 2026-10-23) reads the Superannuation (Unclaimed Money and Lost Members) Regulations 2019 (F2019L01617, compilation F2025C00752, No. 6, 25 July 2025; retrieved 2026-10-23), as deposited at ../../../superannuation-unclaimed-money-and-lost-members-regulations-2019/registers/source-bundle/F2019L01617.txt, with F2019L01617.formulas.md. sumlma-statement-days.l4 (from 2026-10-23) reads the Commissioner's s 15A instrument Unclaimed Money Days and Scheduled Statement Days (F2009L04037) and s 20B instrument Temporary Residents' Superannuation Measure - Scheduled Statement Days 2009 year and onwards (F2009L01210), both as made, retrieved 2026-10-23.

scope: From the member's seat: s 10(1), (2) (eligibility age, the Act's own 65 and 60); s 12(1), (2) and s 13(1), (1A) (unclaimed money, the fund's duty to try to reach me); ss 14, 15(1) (a member who has died); s 20QA(1), (1A) (inactive low-balance account); s 24B (lost member account; 'lost member' asked as a fact); s 20AA(1) (former temporary resident); the days by which my fund must pay the Commissioner under ss 17(1), 20E(2), 20F(1), 20QD(1), 21C(2), 24E(1), and s 22 (voluntary); whom the Commissioner must pay under ss 17(1C)-(2AAB), 20QF(1)-(3), 21E(1)-(3), 22B(1)-(3), 24G(1)-(2A), with the death beneficiaries' share only for one beneficiary; interest due under ss 17(2AB)-(2AE), 20QF(5)-(6), 21E(5)-(6), 22B(5)-(6), 24G(3A)-(3D) (whether, not how much); s 20H(1)-(3) (former temporary resident); s 24NA(1)-(2) (transfer to my active account; s 24NA(3) not covered); recovery of overpayments from me under ss 20L, 20QK, 21G, 22E, 24K and s 24NAA; objection under s 20P. Out: the statements and their errors beyond their due days; the amount formulas (s 17(1A), the death-beneficiary formulas, lost in conversion) and the s 20F(2)-(4) amount; State, Territory and prescribed public sector schemes (ss 18, 18AA, 20JA, 20QG, 20QH, 22D, 24H, 24HA); refunds and repayments between providers and the Commissioner; s 20J except as an objectionable decision; s 20H(2A)-(2C) (pre-2013 interest); registers, tax file numbers, records, penalty amounts and the machinery (Parts 1, 5, 6; ss 19, 20, 20N, 23, 24, 24M). In since 2026-10-23 (sumlma-regulations.l4): the Regulations' reg 5 (eligibility age, and s 12(1) at that age), reg 7 (visas excluded from s 20AA), reg 9 (interest rate and interest for a financial year, CPI numbers as inputs), reg 13 (the s 24NA(2)(c) period), reg 14 (s 24NA(3) choice of fund), reg 20 (KiwiSaver matters). Out of the Regulations: reg 6 (notice contents), reg 8 (pre-2013 interest), regs 10-12 (conditions of release for s 20QA, asked as a fact), Part 7. In since 2026-10-23 (sumlma-statement-days.l4): ss 15A and 20B with the Commissioner's instruments -- the due day under ss 17(1), 20QD(1), 24E(1) from the day the money qualified, and under s 20F(1) from the day of the notice. Added 2026-10-24 (sumlma-formulas.l4), from C2004A00518.formulas.md: the s 17(1A) amount a fund pays, the death beneficiaries' shares (ss 17(2AA), 20QF(4), 21E(4), 22B(4), 24G(3)) and the former temporary resident's death beneficiaries (s 20H(3), (4)).
seat: the member of a superannuation fund, approved deposit fund or RSA; where a member has died, the person entitled to the benefit (a death beneficiary or the legal personal representative); for s 12(2), the non-member spouse under a payment split
